verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single plugins documentation index entry: "Implement event subscriptions and webhook delivery for your MCP server." This suggests the plugin platform has a documented event-subscription and webhook-delivery mechanism. Without the page contents, the direction, registration flow and payloads are unknown. missing for 10: details of how a consumer registers webhook endpoints, event types and payload schema, delivery/retry semantics, confirmation that end users (not just MCP server authors) can subscribe, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
